body: @dario-piotrowicz just wanted to ask if you might be interested in submitting a PR to improve the error message?

> @dario-piotrowicz just wanted to ask if you might be interested in submitting a PR to improve the error message?

Of course!!! :grinning: 

Please leave this with me! :slightly_smiling_face:

Go @dario-piotrowicz , go! I've updated the issue description (it was badly formatted, sorry about that).

The basic idea is to determine the type of a component (standalone or not) and adjust the error message based on this type (the standalone flag can be read from the component def).

 LMK if you've got any questions.
@AndrewKushnir my pleasure, thanks for thinking of me!!! :heart_eyes:

I've opened 2 PRs, respectively for the aot and jit compilations which seem pretty self-contained

I did it so that if I got one completely wrong that at least it should not stop the other PR/change from progressing

I hope that is fine, please let me know if it isn't, in that case I can merge the two PRs into one :slightly_smiling_face:
